title: Description of the Reality of Creation Through the Tree Parable

questions.question: What picture is used at the start of the passage to help explain the main idea?
questions.answer: A huge hidden tree is used as an example.

questions.question: Why must there be balance between a tree and its parts?
questions.answer: Because the branches, fruits, leaves, and blossoms all belong to one living whole and fit its nature.

questions.question: What would it show if a person could correctly draw the hidden tree without seeing it openly?
questions.answer: It would show that the person knows the tree in a deep and complete way.

questions.question: What does the hidden tree stand for in the passage?
questions.answer: It stands for creation and the reality of all created things.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the reach of this tree of creation?
questions.answer: It stretches from the beginning of the world to the hereafter, from the earth up to the divine throne, and from tiny particles to the sun.

questions.question: What does the Qur’an do with the parts of creation in its explanations?
questions.answer: It gives them fitting places and keeps the right connection and measure between them.

questions.question: Who is mentioned as recognizing this excellence after careful study?
questions.answer: Scholars who investigate deeply are mentioned.

questions.question: What do those scholars understand about the Qur’an from its descriptions?
questions.answer: They understand that it explains the universe with amazing wisdom and solves its deep mysteries.

questions.question: Which two big puzzles does the passage say the Qur’an opens up?
questions.answer: The mystery of the universe and the riddle of creation.

questions.question: Is the tree in the example visible or hidden?
questions.answer: It is hidden behind a covering.

questions.question: What kinds of tree parts are named to show its complete structure?
questions.answer: Its branches, fruits, leaves, and blossoms are named.

questions.question: How are the tree’s parts shaped?
questions.answer: Each part is formed in a way that matches the tree’s own nature.

questions.question: What careful work does the artist do on the covering?
questions.answer: The artist marks out each part and draws them in the right pattern and size.

questions.question: Why is it important that the artist keeps the right proportion from branch to fruit to leaf?
questions.answer: Because correct proportion proves that the drawing matches the real hidden tree.

questions.question: What conclusion would people reach about such an artist?
questions.answer: They would conclude that he sees beyond the covering and knows the unseen tree.

questions.question: In the comparison, what takes the place of the artist?
questions.answer: The Qur’an takes that place.

questions.question: What takes the place of the hidden tree?
questions.answer: The whole order of created things takes that place.

questions.question: What quality of the Qur’an’s words is highlighted by this comparison?
questions.answer: Their ability to explain things clearly and with exact balance.

questions.question: According to the passage, how do careful scholars react to this?
questions.answer: They praise Allah and admire the wisdom found in the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the passage say exists between a tree and all its parts?
questions.answer: It says there is harmony, order, and balance between them.

questions.question: What human example is given to help explain this idea?
questions.answer: The relation between the parts of the human body is given.

questions.question: If someone draws a hidden thing exactly right, what does that suggest about his knowledge?
questions.answer: It suggests that his knowledge reaches what others cannot see.

questions.question: How is the Qur’an’s speech described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as speech that separates truth clearly and explains with precision.

questions.question: What subject does the Qur’an explain in this part of the text?
questions.answer: It explains the reality of created things.

questions.question: How large is the world of creation described here?
questions.answer: It is described as extremely vast, covering many levels from the smallest things to the greatest.

questions.question: Why is the mention of both tiny particles and the sun important?
questions.answer: It shows that the Qur’an’s explanation covers everything from very small to very great.

questions.question: What do scholars say after finishing their study of these descriptions?
questions.answer: They say that Allah has willed something wonderful and given great blessings.

questions.question: What special role do they give to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They say it unlocks the deep secrets of the universe and creation.

questions.question: What is unusual about the tree in the opening example?
questions.answer: It is enormous, spreading wide, and hidden from sight.

questions.question: What covers the tree from people’s view?
questions.answer: A veil or covering hides it.

questions.question: What would make a drawing of the hidden tree convincing?
questions.answer: The drawing would need to show each part correctly and connect them in the proper way.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention a great distance between the tree’s beginning and end parts?
questions.answer: To show how hard it would be to know the whole tree unless someone had complete sight of it.

questions.question: What does the passage compare this hard task to?
questions.answer: It compares it to how the Qur’an explains all of creation.

questions.question: How well does the Qur’an preserve the right measure between created things?
questions.answer: It preserves their measure extremely well and gives each one a fitting form.

questions.question: What kind of people are said to have examined these explanations?
questions.answer: People who do deep research and investigation are said to have examined them.

questions.question: After studying, what do they realize about the Qur’an’s explanations?
questions.answer: They realize the explanations are full of wisdom and match reality in an amazing way.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the source of the Qur’an’s knowledge?
questions.answer: It tells us that its knowledge is complete and far beyond ordinary human guessing.

questions.question: What main example is built in the reader’s mind in this passage?
questions.answer: The reader is asked to imagine a giant hidden tree.

questions.question: What idea does the example teach about connected parts?
questions.answer: It teaches that all parts of one thing must match each other properly.

questions.question: What would be amazing about drawing the tree on top of the covering?
questions.answer: The amazing part would be drawing it accurately even though it was hidden.

questions.question: What does accurate drawing prove in this example?
questions.answer: It proves deep sight and full understanding of what is concealed.

questions.question: What does the passage call the world of created things when using the tree image?
questions.answer: It calls it the tree of creation.

questions.question: What time span is included in that tree of creation?
questions.answer: It includes everything from the world’s beginning to the farthest end of the hereafter.

questions.question: What range of place is included in that tree of creation?
questions.answer: It includes everything from the earth to the divine throne.

questions.question: What range of size is included in that tree of creation?
questions.answer: It includes everything from the smallest particles to the sun.

questions.question: How do scholars respond when they see how well the Qur’an explains all this?
questions.answer: They speak with amazement, thankfulness, and praise to Allah.

questions.question: What final conclusion do they reach about the Qur’an?
questions.answer: They conclude that it explains and unties the deepest mysteries of existence.

questions.question: At the beginning of the passage, what is the reader asked to imagine?
questions.answer: The reader is asked to imagine a very strange and enormous hidden tree.

questions.question: Why does the passage say a tree’s parts cannot be random?
questions.answer: Because each part must fit the nature and design of the whole tree.

questions.question: Which parts of the tree are listed to show this order?
questions.answer: The branches, fruits, leaves, and blossoms are listed.

questions.question: What would a person do to show knowledge of the hidden tree?
questions.answer: The person would draw its parts correctly on the veil and place them in proper relation.

questions.question: What makes such drawing more than a lucky guess?
questions.answer: The exact shape, fit, and proportion of all the parts make it more than a guess.

questions.question: How is this example connected to the Qur’an?
questions.answer: It shows that the Qur’an explains creation with exact knowledge and balance.

questions.question: What name is given to all created existence in this comparison?
questions.answer: It is called the tree of creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Qur’an’s treatment of the members and fruits of creation?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an gives them forms and relations that suit them perfectly.

questions.question: What do investigative scholars say after examining these descriptions?
questions.answer: They praise Allah and say the Qur’an wonderfully explains what is hidden in the universe.

questions.question: What big truth is being taught about the Qur’an through all of this?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Qur’an comes with complete wisdom and understanding of all creation.
